# Cinder Steps

## Overview

A stair of burnt stone rising out of standing water, with nothing at the top of it
except what was left there.

## Discovery (Session 4)

Found by accident off the surveyed route. [[Sister Ilva]] was already at the top.

On no chart. Dry, in the middle of standing water, which nobody has explained.
